title: Public claims policy data (policy-data/claims-map.yml)
description: Declarative ledger binding each public supply-chain claim token to the executable Python control that backs it. The validator (tools/verify/validate_claims_parity.py) reads this file; control logic stays in Python. Policy as data, enforcement as code.

claim_surface.description: Where the gate looks for claims. The map describes claims; it does NOT decide where the repo is allowed to state them. include/exclude are repo-root-relative glob patterns.

manual_notes.description: Documented human boundaries that live beside the automated controls — the limits no control can close.

claims.description: One entry per case-sensitive claim token, keyed exactly as the token appears in prose (e.g. SLSA, reproducib).

stated_in.description: Canonical public statement sources (repo-root-relative). Enforced to be a subset of the scanned surface.

verified_by.description: Names of the module-level control_* functions in validate_claims_parity.py. Always a list. May be empty only when status is goal or manual.

pr_gate_check.description: Optional: the checks.py check id that enforces this claim at pr-gate (verified to be BLOCKING when set).
